description: Shape a part's feel toward a reference's, judged on the notes with no listening: where each lane plays (a part on a Drum Rack in lanes by its pads: kick, snare, hats, cymbals and perc; any other part one lane), its timing step by step (push, swing, laid-back hats), its velocity accents, syncopation and fills. Start a run with clip (the part, a MIDI clip) and reference (a MIDI clip with the reference's notes). For a reference's drums: put the track in the Arrangement, separate its stems (live_command separate_stems), convert the drum stem to MIDI (live_command convert_drums_to_midi), and give that MIDI clip as reference and the drum stem's clip as audio: Kumi hears the stem and moves each converted hit onto its real onset. For a pitched part that isn't in Live (a bass line in an audio file), give the file as reference: Kumi turns it into notes with Basic Pitch, on a grid fitted to them (its tempo near reference_tempo or the estimate, and its first downbeat; the reply says it), and its velocities aren't compared. Then change the notes (change_notes, transform_midi swing, quantize) and call groove with change, or let code move the notes toward the reference's timing and accents with apply: true (amount 0–1, all the way when left out). Kumi keeps a change only if its target got closer and nothing else moved away, taking it back otherwise, and names the next target. done: true ends the run with before → after.

clip.description: Starts a run: the part, a MIDI clip's clipRef

reference.description: Starts a run: the reference's MIDI clip (its clipRef), or an audio file of a pitched part that isn't in Live (Basic Pitch turns it into notes, on a grid fitted to them)

reference_tempo.description: With an audio file as the reference: its tempo, BPM: its grid is fitted within 2 % of it (Kumi estimates it when left out, trying half and double too)

audio.description: The reference's drum stem (an Arrangement audio clip's clipRef): its hits' onsets refine the reference's timing

change.description: What you changed in the part, to judge it

apply.description: Code moves the part's notes toward the reference's timing and accents, then judges that

amount.description: With apply: how far (1, all the way, when left out)

done.description: Ends the run: before → after on every line
